# Qicable

> Industrial cables and custom cable assemblies for equipment manufacturers and system integrators.

This directory lists public website pages under the owner-authorized all-public discovery setting. Directory inclusion does not mark draft product facts or translations as approved.

Technical guides are selection checklists, not evidence of a model’s performance or certification. Prices, lead times, minimum order quantities and final configurations are confirmed in the quotation.

## English

- [Industrial Cable Assembly Manufacturer | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/): Standard and custom connections for machine vision, automation and industrial equipment, with locking, angled and panel mount configurations.
- [Industrial cable assemblies | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/products/): Explore by product family, interface or model. Open a product to check the connections and send a specific requirement.
- [Machine Vision Cables | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/products/machine-vision/): Connect industrial cameras to the rest of your system. Choose by interface, connector orientation and installation conditions.
- [Industrial Ethernet Cables | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/products/industrial-ethernet/): Find the right connection between equipment, switches and industrial networks. Check both connectors and the required cable specification.
- [Circular Cable Assemblies | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/products/m8-m12/): Match sensor connections by connector size, coding, pin count and cable termination.
- [Industrial Communication Cables | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/products/industrial-communication/): Connect control equipment with serial, console and D-Sub cable assemblies. Check the signal type and pinout.
- [Industrial Display Cables | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/products/industrial-display/): Bring display connections into industrial PCs, HMI panels and equipment. Review the interface, length and installation space.
- [Panel Mount Cables | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/products/panel-mount/): Bring an interface through your equipment enclosure. Match the panel opening, mounting dimensions and connectors.

- [Cable Selection for Robotics | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/applications/robotics/): Plan connections for moving equipment. Review bend radius, routing, torsion and the required flex life against the cable specification.
- [Cable Connections for Industrial PCs & HMI | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/applications/industrial-pc-hmi/): Connect industrial computers, displays and operator panels. Review signal compatibility, locking connectors and access through the enclosure.

The named holder, covered products and validity are defined by each original document; some relate to manufacturing partners. Request a readable current copy for your model and project.

- [Machine Vision Cable Selection: Connectors and Locks | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/machine-vision-cable-selection-guide/): Start a machine vision cable inquiry with the camera, host and installation route. A familiar connector shape is only one part of a reliable imaging connection.
- [M12 Coding and Pinout: D vs X and Wiring Views | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/m12-coding-guide/): Specify an M12 assembly by coding, contacts and wiring, then confirm its mechanical installation. The M12 name by itself is not a complete purchasing specification.
- [Continuous Flex vs Torsion: Specify Cable Motion | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/static-vs-continuous-flex-cables/): Separate fixed installation, repeated bending and torsion before selecting a cable. Describing the actual movement is more useful than asking for a cable that is simply flexible.
- [Panel-Mount Cable Fit: Cutout, Thickness and Clearance | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/panel-mount-cable-dimensions-guide/): A panel cable must fit the enclosure and the mating plug on both sides. Use a dimensioned installation drawing before releasing a panel cutout or cable order.
- [RS232, RS485 and TTL connections | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/rs232-vs-rs485-vs-ttl/): Before ordering a serial cable or converter, identify the electrical interface at each end. RS-232, RS-485 and TTL-level UART connections are not interchangeable just because the plugs fit.
- [Cable shielding and grounding | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/cable-shielding-grounding-guide/): Plan shielding together with the equipment grounding design and cable route. A shielded cable label alone does not describe how the completed installation will handle interference.
- [USB3 Vision Cable Length: Passive, Active or Optical? | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/usb3-vision-cable-length-guide/): Choose USB3 Vision cable length by the camera, host, power path and installed route. Compare passive, active and optical options before agreeing a sample acceptance test.
- [GigE Vision Packet Loss: Cable or Network? | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/gige-vision-packet-loss-troubleshooting/): Troubleshoot GigE Vision packet loss by separating the physical connection from network load and acquisition settings. Use controlled comparisons before deciding that a replacement cable is required.
- [Cable Assembly RFQ Checklist: Drawing and Test Scope | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/custom-cable-assembly-rfq-checklist/): Prepare a custom cable assembly RFQ with both interfaces, a view-labeled pin map, length and test requirements. A clear drawing revision makes quotations and sample acceptance easier to compare.
- [USB-to-RS485 Wiring: Polarity, Termination and Timeouts | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/usb-rs485-wiring-troubleshooting/): Check USB-to-RS485 wiring, A/B definitions, termination and device settings before replacing a converter cable. Use the manuals for both ends and document each isolation test.

- [Einbaukabel: Ausschnitt, Wandstärke und Freiraum | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/de/blog/panel-mount-cable-dimensions-guide/): Ein Einbaukabel muss zum Gehäuse und zu den Gegensteckern auf beiden Seiten passen. Geben Sie Ausschnitt und Kabel erst anhand einer bemaßten Einbauzeichnung frei.
- [RS232, RS485 und TTL | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/de/blog/rs232-vs-rs485-vs-ttl/): Bestimmen Sie vor der Bestellung eines seriellen Kabels oder Wandlers die elektrische Schnittstelle beider Geräte. Passende Stecker machen RS-232, RS-485 und TTL-UART nicht austauschbar.
- [Schirmung und Erdung | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/de/blog/cable-shielding-grounding-guide/): Planen Sie Schirmung gemeinsam mit Erdungskonzept und Kabelweg. Die Bezeichnung geschirmtes Kabel erklärt noch nicht das Störverhalten der vollständigen Anlage.
- [USB3-Vision-Kabellänge: passiv, aktiv oder optisch? | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/de/blog/usb3-vision-cable-length-guide/): USB3-Vision-Kabellängen anhand von Kamera, Host, Versorgung und Verlegeweg auswählen. Passive, aktive und optische Varianten vor einer vereinbarten Musterprüfung vergleichen.

Kontrollierte Vergleiche helfen vor einem Kabeltausch.
- [Kabelkonfektion anfragen: Zeichnung und Prüfumfang | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/de/blog/custom-cable-assembly-rfq-checklist/): Eine Kabelkonfektion mit beiden Schnittstellen, eindeutigem Pinplan, Länge und Prüfumfang anfragen. - [Conexiones RS232, RS485 y TTL | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/es/blog/rs232-vs-rs485-vs-ttl/): Antes de pedir un cable o convertidor serie, identifique la interfaz eléctrica de ambos extremos. RS-232, RS-485 y UART TTL no son intercambiables aunque los enchufes encajen.
- [Blindaje y puesta a tierra | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/es/blog/cable-shielding-grounding-guide/): Planifique el blindaje junto al diseño de puesta a tierra y el recorrido. La etiqueta de cable blindado no describe el comportamiento de toda la instalación ante interferencias.

- [Pérdida de paquetes GigE Vision: ¿cable o red? | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/es/blog/gige-vision-packet-loss-troubleshooting/): Separe conexión física, carga de red y ajustes al investigar pérdidas de paquetes GigE Vision. Compare de forma controlada antes de atribuir el fallo al cable.
- [Consulta de conjuntos de cables: plano y pruebas | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/es/blog/custom-cable-assembly-rfq-checklist/): Prepare su RFQ de conjuntos de cables con interfaces, vistas de pines, longitud y pruebas. Una revisión clara del plano permite comparar ofertas y aceptar muestras.

- [Ligações de cabos para automação industrial | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/applications/factory-automation/): Ligue sensores, controladores e redes industriais. Defina codificação, pinagem, percurso do cabo e proteção ambiental necessária.
- [Seleção de cabos para robótica | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/applications/robotics/): Planeie ligações para equipamentos em movimento. Verifique raio de curvatura, percurso, torção e ciclos de flexão face à especificação do cabo.
- [Ligações de cabos para PC industriais e HMI | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/applications/industrial-pc-hmi/): Ligue computadores industriais, ecrãs e painéis de operador. Verifique compatibilidade do sinal, bloqueio dos conectores e passagem pela caixa.
- [Conjuntos de cabos para integração de equipamentos | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/applications/equipment-integration/): Integre alimentação, dados e controlo no equipamento. Coordene desenhos, comprimentos, pinagens e identificação dos conjuntos.
- [Conjuntos de cabos industriais sob medida | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/custom-cable-assemblies/): Indique conectores, pinagem, comprimento e condições de instalação. A nossa equipa analisará o desenho e os requisitos do conjunto.

- [Cabos de visão: conectores, bloqueio e percurso | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/blog/machine-vision-cable-selection-guide/): Comece a consulta de cabos de visão de máquina pela câmera, pelo host e pelo percurso. O formato do conector é apenas uma parte de uma conexão de imagem confiável.
- [Codificação e pinagem M12: D, X e vistas | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/blog/m12-coding-guide/): Especifique um conjunto M12 pela codificação, pelos contatos e pela ligação, e depois confirme a montagem. A designação M12 não basta para uma especificação de compra.
- [Flexão contínua e torção: definir o movimento | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/blog/static-vs-continuous-flex-cables/): Diferencie instalação fixa, flexão repetida e torção antes de escolher o cabo. Descrever o movimento real é mais útil do que pedir apenas um cabo flexível.
- [Cabos de painel: abertura, espessura e espaço | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/blog/panel-mount-cable-dimensions-guide/): Um cabo de painel deve caber no gabinete e nos conectores dos dois lados. Use um desenho cotado antes de aprovar o recorte do painel ou o pedido.
- [Ligações RS232, RS485 e TTL | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/blog/rs232-vs-rs485-vs-ttl/): Antes de comprar um cabo ou conversor serial, identifique a interface elétrica de cada extremidade. RS-232, RS-485 e UART TTL não são intercambiáveis apenas porque os plugues encaixam.
- [Blindagem e ligação à terra | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/blog/cable-shielding-grounding-guide/): Planeje a blindagem junto com o aterramento e o percurso. A indicação cabo blindado não descreve, por si só, o comportamento da instalação completa diante de interferências.
- [Comprimento USB3 Vision: cabo passivo, ativo ou ótico? | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/blog/usb3-vision-cable-length-guide/): Escolha o comprimento USB3 Vision segundo câmara, host, alimentação e percurso. Compare opções passivas, ativas e óticas antes de acordar o ensaio da amostra.
- [Perda de pacotes GigE Vision: cabo ou rede? | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/blog/gige-vision-packet-loss-troubleshooting/): Separe ligação física, carga da rede e ajustes ao investigar perdas de pacotes GigE Vision. Compare de forma controlada antes de culpar o cabo.
- [Pedido de orçamento de cabos: desenho e testes | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/blog/custom-cable-assembly-rfq-checklist/): Prepare o pedido de orçamento com interfaces, vistas da pinagem, comprimento e testes. Uma revisão clara do desenho facilita comparar propostas e aceitar amostras.
- [Ligação USB a RS485: polaridade, terminação e tempos | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pt/blog/usb-rs485-wiring-troubleshooting/): Verifique cablagem USB a RS485, definições A/B, terminação e ajustes antes de substituir o conversor. Utilize ambos os manuais e documente os testes.

Opis rzeczywistego ruchu jest bardziej użyteczny niż pytanie o kabel, który jest po prostu elastyczny.
- [Dopasowanie przewodu do montażu panelowego: wycięcie, grubość i luz | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pl/blog/panel-mount-cable-dimensions-guide/): Kabel panelowy musi pasować do obudowy i współpracującego wtyku po obu stronach. Przed zatwierdzeniem wycięcia w panelu lub zamówienia kabla użyj rysunku instalacyjnego z wymiarami.
- [Połączenia RS232 , RS485 i TTL | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pl/blog/rs232-vs-rs485-vs-ttl/): Przed zamówieniem kabla szeregowego lub konwertera ustal interfejs elektryczny na obu końcach. Połączenia RS-232 , RS-485 i TTL-level UART nie są wymienne tylko dlatego, że wtyki pasują.
- [Ekranowanie i uziemienie kabli | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/pl/blog/cable-shielding-grounding-guide/): Zaplanuj ekranowanie razem z projektem uziemienia urządzenia i trasą kabla. Sama etykieta kabla ekranowanego nie opisuje, jak ukończona instalacja poradzi sobie z zakłóceniami.

- [Om Qicable | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/sv/about/): Qicable är det industriella anslutningsvarumärket för Ningbo Farsince Electronic Co., Ltd. Vi betjänar utrustningstillverkare, systemintegratörer och distributionspartner med industrikablar och anpassade kabelmontage.
- [Diskutera dina kabelkrav | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/sv/contact/): Dela en modell eller beskriv din applikation. Inkludera en ritningslänk om du har en.
- [Begär kabelprover | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/sv/request-samples/): Utvärdera en kabel i din utrustning innan du planerar en större order. Börja med modellen och de frågor som ditt test behöver besvara.
- [Teknisk support och ordersupport | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/sv/technical-support/): Välj den fråga du behöver lösa. Att ge rätt sammanhang hjälper oss att granska din kabelapplikation eller befintliga order.
- [Distribution och OEM partnerskap | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/sv/partners/): Diskutera ett leveransprogram för industrikablar för din distributörsverksamhet, utrustningsplattform eller privatmärkta sortiment.
- [Integritetspolicy | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/sv/privacy/): Hur Qicable hanterar informationen du delar när du diskuterar ett industriellt kabelprojekt.
- [Cookies och lokal lagring | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/sv/cookies/): Förstå vad den här webbplatsen kommer ihåg på din enhet och hur du hanterar det.

- [Inköp och eftermarknad | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/sv/purchasing/): Uppgifter för att förbereda en order, komma överens om leveransdetaljer och anmäla ett produktproblem. Specifika villkor hör hemma i din skriftliga offert och orderbekräftelse.

- [Kabelforbindelser til industrielle pc'er og HMI | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/da/applications/industrial-pc-hmi/): Forbind industrielle computere, skærme og operatørpaneler. Gennemgå signalkompatibilitet, låsestik og adgang gennem kabinettet.

- [M12 kodning og pinout: D vs X og ledningsvisninger | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/da/blog/m12-coding-guide/): Angiv en M12 assembling efter kodning, kontakter og ledningsføring, og bekræft derefter dens mekaniske installation. Navnet M12 alene er ikke en fuldstændig købsspecifikation.
- [Konstant fleksibilitet vs. torsion: Angiv kabelbevægelsen | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/da/blog/static-vs-continuous-flex-cables/): Adskil fast installation, gentagen bøjning og torsion, før du vælger et kabel. At beskrive den faktiske bevægelse er mere nyttigt end at spørge efter et kabel, der blot er fleksibelt.

Brug en målsat installationstegning, før du frigiver en paneludskæring eller kabelordre.
- [RS232 -, RS485 - og TTL-tilslutninger | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/da/blog/rs232-vs-rs485-vs-ttl/): Før bestilling af et serielt kabel eller en konverter skal den elektriske grænseflade identificeres i hver ende. RS-232 , RS-485 og TTL-level UART-forbindelser kan ikke udskiftes, blot fordi stikkene passer.

Brug kontrollerede sammenligninger, før du beslutter, at et erstatningskabel er nødvendigt.

- [Innkjøp og ettersalg | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/no/purchasing/): Informasjon for å forberede en ordre, avtale leveringsdetaljer og melde et produktproblem. Spesifikke betingelser hører hjemme i ditt skriftlige tilbud og ordrebekreftelse.

- [ケーブルのシールドと接地 | Qicable](https://www.qicable.com/ja/blog/cable-shielding-grounding-guide/): シールドは、機器の接地設計およびケーブル経路と併せて計画してください。シールドケーブルという表示だけでは、完成した設置が干渉をどのように扱うかは示されません。
